root.name: antisamy
root.description: A library for performing fast,configurable cleansing of HTML coming from untrusted sources

enhancements.enhancement: Attribute parsing limit - Only the limited number of attributes scanned and validated by the Antisamy, remaining attributes will be removed. The default limit is 1000.It will substantially reduce the attribute scanning time.
Insert Attribute Feature - It is used to insert the configured attribute to the tag, if the configured criteria met. It can prevent location spoofing attack which is possible via target="_blank".
Mandatory Attribute - Some attributes are mandatory for HTML tags, if those attributes are not present, then HTML tag will be remove.
WAF URL Validation Adoption - to validate url attributes such as href
Migrated Antisamy from batik.jar to cssparser.jar which supports CSS3.
Dropped all httpclient and httpcore jar dependencies in antisamy CSS filtering, to rule out any SSRF attacks posing as import URls.
style import hacks fixed by adding case-insensitive check for style tag

Extend policy customisation - Introduced new custom attribute 'remove=true'. used to remove existing configuration from the policy and it's play vital role while extending policy files with removing some configuration like directives, common-attributes ... etc.
Directive skipEscapeHtmlTags - to avoid html encoding for non HTML cases like 1 < 2
Directive encodeNonBreakingSpace - used to avoid decoding of   to space
Directive skipEscapeSingleQuote - To avoid single quote encoding for internal styles
Directive includeCssSpace - To remove the space in between the css property and its value
Directive preserveCssUrlQuotes - To preserve quotes inside the css function url
